_doc: F6 import template — copy this to your own file, fill in the cards you want, and run: pnpm run import:cards <your-file>. The importer upserts Orgs + Persons + BattleCards. Existing rows (matching by org_id or org match_key) are updated in place. Required: org_id, name, kind, who_they_are, why_matters, trap_to_avoid. Optional: D2 fields (way_in/opening/receipt), suggested_questions (max 3), sources, known_people, persons. SourcedFacts default to [I] confidence; Cassin can promote to [O]/[V] via PUT /api/v1/battle-cards/:org_id after import.

_confidence_values.V: primary source (operator domain, tender portal, signed doc) OR ≥2 independent non-primary sources OR human confirmation
_confidence_values.I: model inference — always labeled with inputs

cards._example: Existing org from the seed (PKP PLK) — overwriting its battle card with Cassin-curated doctrine
cards.name: PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe
cards.who_they_are: PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe — Polish national rail infrastructure manager. Owns the network + yards.
cards.why_matters: Poland is the platform's primary dossier. PLK is the buyer of record for every hump-yard modernization on the Polish network.
cards.trap_to_avoid: PKP S.A. is the holding company — PLK owns the yards. Ask who opens PLK, not PKP S.A.
cards.way_in: Doctrine: get DECEL's specs written into PLK's 'Code for Design on Hump and Marshalling Yards' technical reference before any tender goes live.
cards.opening: Open with: 'We are aware PLK is reviewing its track-brake specifications for Idzikowice and would value a technical exchange on modern alternatives.'
cards.receipt: Cassin: 'Yes, we'll loop in our PLK liaison and get a meeting on the Q4 2026 calendar.' → monday Play with date.
suggested_questions: Where is the 'Code for Design on Hump and Marshalling Yards' in its current revision cycle?
Which yards are on the 2027 capex list?
Is PLK open to a technical exchange before the Idzikowice tender brief is finalised?

sources.title: PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe — official site

cards._example: New org from the Phase 2 finish seed (AŽD Praha) — first card for the CZ radar case
cards.name: AŽD Praha s.r.o.
cards.who_they_are: AŽD Praha — Czech rail systems integrator. Hall 27/640 at InnoTrans Berlin 2026.
cards.why_matters: AŽD is the local CZ integrator for the Ostrava brand-new hump in design (MORAVIA CONSULT Olomouc, docs 2026, build ≥2028, 8→30 bn CZK). Get DECEL into AŽD's spec pull for the Ostrava tender.
cards.trap_to_avoid: AŽD integrates — they don't decide retarder spec alone. The decision is at SŽ (Správa železnic). Position AŽD as the spec carrier, not the decision-maker.
cards.way_in: Doctrine: meet AŽD at InnoTrans Hall 27/640, walk through the Ostrava timeline, ask for a 1:1 in October at hannover messe or directly at AŽD's Praha HQ.
cards.opening: Open with: 'We're tracking the Ostrava hump design and want to make sure the retarder spec aligns with modern practice before MORAVIA CONSULT finalises the brief.'
cards.receipt: Cassin: 'Yes, set up the AŽD meeting for late October, I'll bring the Ostrava timeline PDF.'
suggested_questions: Where is the Ostrava retarder spec in MORAVIA CONSULT's design pack?
Is AŽD the integrator on Ostrava or only on the signalling?
Does AŽD have a relationship with SŽ's procurement team?
